title: Sort Records inside Loop
description: Performance rule — Sort Records executed inside a Loop; sorting per iteration is rarely intended.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Sorting the found set on every loop iteration is expensive and usually redundant.
rule.remediation: Sort once before the loop, or drop the in-loop sort entirely.
